problem:
Find the general solution to the problem

$$
\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}+2\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}-3y=2\operatorname{cos}⁡x+\operatorname{sin}⁡x.
$$

activity_context.topic_title: Second-Order Inhomogeneous ODEs With Sinusoidal Forcing

feedback.problem:
Given that the differential equation 

$$
\frac{{\text{d}}^{2}y}{\text{d}{x}^{2}}-\frac{\text{d}y}{\text{d}x}+\frac{y}{4}=25\operatorname{cos}⁡x
$$

has the complementary function ${y}_{c}(x)=A{e}^{x/2}+Bx{e}^{x/2}$, find the particular solution ${y}_{p}(x)$ to this equation.
feedback.worked_solution:
The right-hand side of the inhomogeneous equation is $25\operatorname{cos}⁡x.$ Therefore, we assume that the particular solution of the form

$$
{y}_{p}=\alpha \operatorname{cos}⁡x+\beta \operatorname{sin}⁡x,
$$

where $\alpha $ and $\beta $ are constants that are to be determined. 

Calculating the first and second derivatives of ${y}_{p}$ gives:

$$
\begin{aligned}\frac{\text{d}{y}_{p}}{\text{d}x} & =-\alpha \operatorname{sin}⁡x+\beta \operatorname{cos}⁡x \\ \frac{{\text{d}}^{2}{y}_{p}}{\text{d}{x}^{2}} & =-\alpha \operatorname{cos}⁡x-\beta \operatorname{sin}⁡x\end{aligned}
$$

To find the values of $\alpha $ and $\beta ,$ we substitute the derivatives into the differential equation:

$$
(-\alpha \operatorname{cos}⁡x-\beta \operatorname{sin}⁡x)-(-\alpha \operatorname{sin}⁡x+\beta \operatorname{cos}⁡x)+\frac{\alpha \operatorname{cos}⁡x+\beta \operatorname{sin}⁡x}{4}=25\operatorname{cos}⁡x
$$

Grouping the terms on the left-hand side gives

$$
(-\frac{3}{4}\alpha -\beta )\operatorname{cos}⁡x+(\alpha -\frac{3}{4}\beta )\operatorname{sin}⁡x=25\operatorname{cos}⁡x.
$$

Equating the coefficients, we get the following system of equations:

$$
\begin{aligned}{\begin{aligned}-\frac{3}{4}\alpha -\beta =25\, & (\text{equating the coefficients of}\,\operatorname{cos}⁡x) \\ \alpha -\frac{3}{4}\beta =0\, & (\text{equating the coefficients of}\,\operatorname{sin}⁡x)\end{aligned}\end{aligned}
$$

Solving this system gives $\alpha =-12$ and $\beta =-16.$

Therefore, the particular solution ${y}_{p}(x)$ is

$$
{y}_{p}(x)=-12\operatorname{cos}⁡x-16\operatorname{sin}⁡x.
$$
